ai.gk: Gemini is Google's AI chatbot. It was launched as Bard in 2023 and renamed Gemini in February 2024. 'K-12' means kindergarten to Class 12. AI Overviews are the AI-written summaries shown at the top of Google Search results.

quiz.explain: Google said Gemini and Search will be off by default; a school administrator can turn them back on.
quiz.q: Which two Google tools will be switched off by default for school (K-12) student accounts?

ai.summary: On 3 November, Google said it will turn off its Gemini chatbot and Google Search by default for K-12 student accounts from early next year. A school administrator can switch either or both back on, but Search without AI summaries will not be offered. Google says schools asked for more control; critics, including some US senators and child-safety groups, say schools are being pushed to accept AI in order to keep Search.
ai.title: Google to switch off Gemini and Search by default for school student accounts

ai.gk: The Hour of Code was started in 2013 by the non-profit Code.org to introduce students to computer science in one hour. Minecraft has been owned by Microsoft since 2014, when it bought the game's maker Mojang. OpenAI is the company that makes ChatGPT.

quiz.explain: The Hour of AI took the place of the Hour of Code, which began in 2013.
quiz.q: The 'Hour of AI' replaced which earlier worldwide classroom event?

ai.summary: The Hour of AI is an AI-literacy activity for school students that replaced the well-known Hour of Code last year. OpenAI is the Lead Partner for the 2026 edition and Microsoft is a supporter. Microsoft will show teachers a Minecraft-themed Hour of AI activity in a webinar on 17 November. The push comes soon after two of the largest US school districts restricted generative AI for students.
ai.title: OpenAI is Lead Partner for the 2026 'Hour of AI'; Microsoft plans a Minecraft AI lesson

aqi.note: City averages from CPCB as reported on 9 November, the day after Diwali. Individual stations can read much higher.

headlines.gk: Nyoma is in eastern Ladakh, close to the Line of Actual Control with China. The IL-76 is a Russian-origin four-engine heavy-lift aircraft that the IAF calls 'Gajraj'.
headlines.summary: An IL-76MD heavy transport aircraft of the Indian Air Force landed at the Nyoma airbase in eastern Ladakh, which sits at 13,629 feet. The landing is being described as an aviation record for the Air Force.
headlines.title: Indian Air Force lands IL-76MD transport aircraft at Nyoma airbase, 13,629 feet up

headlines.gk: COP stands for Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC, the UN climate convention adopted in 1992. The Paris Agreement of 2015 aims to hold warming well below 2°C and pursue 1.5°C. COP30 was held in Belém, Brazil, in 2025.
headlines.summary: The 31st United Nations climate conference, COP31, is set to open in the Turkish city of Antalya, where countries will negotiate the next steps on cutting emissions and climate finance.
headlines.title: COP31 climate summit set to open in Antalya

headlines.gk: India's National Air Quality Index was launched in 2014. It has six bands from Good (0–50) to Severe (401–500) and tracks eight pollutants, including PM2.5 and PM10. In Delhi-NCR, curbs are triggered under GRAP, the Graded Response Action Plan.
headlines.summary: A day after Diwali, CPCB data put Delhi's Air Quality Index at 370, Ghaziabad at 363 and Noida at 340, all in the 'very poor' band. Several monitoring stations, including New Tehsil-Loni in Ghaziabad (463), crossed 400 into 'severe'.
headlines.title: Post-Diwali smog: Delhi's AQI at 370, Ghaziabad and Noida also 'very poor'

headlines.gk: CBSE is a national school board under the Union Ministry of Education, headquartered in New Delhi. It took its present name in 1952.
headlines.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education has released the timetable for the 2027 Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations. Class 12 exams are scheduled from February 16 to April 8.
headlines.title: CBSE releases 2027 board exam timetable; Class 12 papers run 16 February to 8 April

headlines.gk: The UPSC is a constitutional body set up under Article 315. The Civil Services Examination has three stages: Preliminary, Main and the Personality Test (interview). It recruits for services such as the IAS, IPS and IFS.
headlines.summary: The Union Public Service Commission has announced the result of the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026. A total of 2,526 candidates have qualified for the interview round, the final stage of the exam.
headlines.title: UPSC Civil Services Mains 2026 result out; 2,526 candidates qualify for the interview

headlines.gk: Grandmaster is the highest title in chess and is awarded by FIDE, the world chess federation. India's first Grandmaster was Viswanathan Anand, in 1988.
headlines.summary: Anuj Shrivatri has become India's 100th Grandmaster. He is also the first Grandmaster from Madhya Pradesh.
headlines.title: Anuj Shrivatri becomes India's 100th chess Grandmaster

headlines.gk: WTA is the Women's Tennis Association, the body that runs the women's professional tour. It was founded in 1973 by Billie Jean King.
headlines.summary: At the Chennai Open, Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale reached the doubles final, becoming the first all-Indian pair to do so at a WTA Tour-level tennis event.
headlines.title: Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale are the first all-Indian pair in a WTA Tour-level doubles final

headlines.gk: The São Paulo Grand Prix is run at Interlagos, officially the Autódromo José Carlos Pace. Lando Norris is a British driver, and McLaren is a British team based in Woking.
headlines.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won the Formula 1 São Paulo Grand Prix.
headlines.title: Lando Norris wins the Formula 1 São Paulo Grand Prix for McLaren

headlines.gk: Midterm elections are held halfway through a US president's four-year term. All 435 seats of the House of Representatives and about one-third of the 100 Senate seats are contested.
headlines.summary: In the November 3 US midterm elections, the Democratic Party won control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. President Donald Trump has since said his immigration policy was 'too tough' and that he is ready to work with Democrats.
headlines.title: After Democrats win the US House and Senate, Trump says he is ready to work with them

headlines.gk: E20 means petrol blended with 20% ethanol. Ethanol is a biofuel made in India mainly from sugarcane and grains, and blending it reduces crude oil imports. Oil marketing companies include IOCL, BPCL and HPCL.
headlines.summary: Karnataka minister Rizwan Arshad said the state stands by its finding that oil marketing companies blended more than the prescribed 20% ethanol in petrol. The state tested 63 samples from pumps, and some reached 31.2%.
headlines.title: Karnataka says petrol samples had up to 31.2% ethanol against the 20% limit

Lando Norris, winner of the São Paulo Grand Prix, drives for which Formula 1 team?
